company.shortDescription: Upflow is a technology company building a payment platform for B2B businesses.
company.description:
Upflow is the software company revolutionizing how B2B businesses get paid.

The platform help companies manage their unpaid invoices and improve their cash collection by using the company's SaaS-based payment platform.

Alexandre Louisy and Barnaby Malet started the company in 2018.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Undisclosed round raised $5,000,000, or 21.86% of reported total funding.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,155,050 to $104,584,372, a 25.17x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
